description: Domain lookup in one call: DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA with TTLs), registry RDAP registration data (registrar, created, updated and expiry dates, status, nameservers, DNSSEC) and the TLS certificate (issuer, names, validity, days left, chain verified). Use to check a domain before linking to, buying or trusting it. No registrant contact data. Typical response 1 to 2 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.01 (USDC, x402).
name: quantagentshop_domain_lookup
title: Domain lookup
